title.narrative: Exports of selected horticulture crops as a percentage of total agriculture exports excluding horticulture

description.narrative: Definition: Total value of coffee, tea and horticulture exports (USD) expressed as a percentage of total agricultural exports (USD).**In the context of this indicator, total agriculture exports include (i) traditional exports (coffee, cotton, sisal, tea, tobacco, cashew nuts & cloves) and (ii) selected nontraditional exports (fish and fish products and horticulture products). **This indicator is calculated by summing up the value of exports (USD) for coffee, tea and horticulture divided by total value of agriculture exports (USD) multiplied by 100.Summary of Progress:Current Value: 36.9Date: June 30, 2021The value of 36.9% has been calculated by summing the value of exports (USD) for coffee, tea and horticulture for 2020 (452 Million USD) divided by total value of agriculture exports (1,222 Million USD) multiplied by 100. In 2020, the value of exports were as follows: coffee (145.2 Million USD), tea (32.4 Million USD) and horticulture products (274. 1 Million USD). However, it should be noted that the value of exports for coffee and tea in 2020 decreased by 4.6% and 29.1% respectively from 2019. Nevertheless, exports for horticulture increased significantly by 35.4% in 2020.

title.narrative: Income of small scale farmers working in the selected value chains

description.narrative: Definition: Average annual income (Tsh) of all households targeted by the programme in the selected value chains of coffee, tea and horticulture during the previous year. This indicator is calculated from grantees household surveys as an average by summing up total annual income of smallholder farmers earned during the previous year from all sources including sale of coffee, tea and horticulture divided by the total number of smallholder farmers interviewed.Summary of Progress:Current Value:Date: December 31, 2021Data on income of small holder farmers working in the selected value chains will be gathered during the next household surveys to be done during the midterm evaluation of the programme.
